A.claim: ExponentReduction.lean duplicates the definition of IsBealCounterexample already present in Conjecture.lean, with a different gcd association (gcd (gcd A B) C vs gcd3 A B C = gcd A (gcd B C)) and the last two fields in the opposite order.

B.claim: The abc conjecture implies only that there are FINITELY MANY counterexamples to Beal, not that there are none; and the finiteness is ineffective. Therefore no route through abc - including inter-universal Teichmuller theory - can resolve Beal.
